project.visitorDecision: Decide which section the NCC currently reports as skateable and locate an official-listed entrance without treating historical reports as current access permission.
project.primaryAction: Select a section, inspect the NCC source time and current condition, then check the official entrance map before approaching the ice.

claims.subject: route-guidance
claims.limitation: The 14 section polygons and lengths are official reference geometry, not public entrances, skating tracks or guaranteed continuity between opened portions.

claims.subject: other
claims.limitation: NCC typically updates reports twice daily when skating is open. Only complete recent source data may show reported conditions; changes can happen between browser requests.

claims.subject: route-guidance
claims.limitation: Eleven listed access points, five described as universally accessible, do not prove stairs, ramps, transit or parking will be available on an intended date.

claims.subject: park-access
claims.limitation: The archived dataset was last modified 2026-03-05 UTC. It cannot be used to grant skating access for winter 2026-27.

claims.subject: other
claims.limitation: A January 2025 photograph illustrates Dow's Lake, not current ice conditions, status or open entrance.

decisionState.selectedIdField: selection, an NCC integer section ID from 1 to 14
decisionState.sourceOfTruth: Live official public ArcGIS status and editingInfo.dataLastEditDate pass through RideauSkatewayPolicy.assess against the archived NCC audited 14-section reference. No weather-based opening model.
decisionState.unavailableBehavior: If NCC observations are stale, future-dated, incomplete or unreachable, the visitor sees no positive opening and can still use the 14 reference sections, official NCC map and current-condition links.

scenarios.input: Open page Nov 17 with last archived NCC source
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Show no current skating opening verified, official source actions and the audited 14 section directory.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: March 2026 source edit must not imply November or winter 2026-27 skating access.

scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Update section name, physical length, corresponding NCC section marker, official relevant access names and Google Maps searches.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: A section centroid never becomes an access ramp or a proven safe path.

scenarios.input: Choose Rideau to Mackenzie King, then Bank to Bronson, then Rideau
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Restore one consistent section in selected panel, aria-current, URL and map marker.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: Selection does not change source timestamps or fabricate a new skating report.

scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Keep 14 source-linked section names and direct NCC ice/access links in initial HTML.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: No status from an earlier skating season is represented as today's opening.

scenarios.input: Remove Leaflet or block tile provider
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Keep source-linked segment list, selected source panel, entrances and Google Maps place searches.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: No empty map stage or invented route replaces an unavailable map.

scenarios.input: NCC metadata older than 18 hours, future-dated, missing or unknown section schema
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Show status unverified, omit all positive open counts and link directly to the NCC.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: Old Good or Open statuses never authorize entry, even if old map markers exist.

scenarios.input: Use complete NCC-shaped 14-section fixture with one Good report at simulated January 21, 2027 clock
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Show exactly one reported-open section under filtering with dated, explicitly sourced condition.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: Fixture is a test and does not imply real NCC issuance or independent ice approval.

scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Keep section choices, maps, official statuses and entrance links without a broken condition panel.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: Image is contextual 2025 scenery only; loaded image never used as evidence for current ice.

failures.no-js: Initial HTML presents the NCC status page, current access map, 14 documented section names and cautious planning copy; all important official links work without scripts.
failures.no-tiles: The static and dynamic selected-section list, current source result, source timestamp and official access links remain when the map is unavailable.
failures.no-image: The single archival photo can fail without affecting or delaying the ice status, selected section, official source or entrance search.
failures.stale-data: The pure source policy removes all opened-section claims if any NCC section is missing or the timestamp is older than 18 hours, in the future or outside the skating season.
